If the tile is face-up. In general, this is meant to mean that the tile is face up to all players. UI for a player's hand is encouraged to just ignore it in favor of showing the player.

RawRank

The "raw" rank of the tile, ignoring red fives. That is, it is the same as Rank, unless that is 0, in which case this returns 5.

Methods

CompareTo(Tile)

Compares the current instance with another object of the same type and returns an integer that indicates whether the current instance precedes, follows, or occurs in the same position in the sort order as the other object.

public int CompareTo(Tile that)

Parameters

that Tile

A Tile to compare with this instance.

Returns

int

A value that indicates the relative order of the objects being compared. The return value has these meanings:

ValueMeaning
Less than zeroThis instance precedes that in the sort order.
Zero This instance occurs in the same position in the sort order as that.
Greater than zeroThis instance follows that in the sort order.

Remarks

Comparison is done by comparing:

  1. if that is null (always 1)
  2. Suit
  3. Rank, accounting for placing rank 0 (red five) after rank 5.

Equals(Tile)

Indicates whether the current object is equal to another object of the same type.

public bool Equals(Tile that)

Parameters

that Tile

The Tile to compare with the current object.

Returns

bool

true if the current object is equal to the that parameter; otherwise, false.

Remarks

Equality is determined by:

  1. if that is null (always false)
  2. if Suits equal
  3. if Ranks equal

Note that FaceUp is NOT considered.

public override bool Equals(object that)

Parameters

that object

Returns

bool

true if the specified object is equal to the current object; otherwise, false.

Remarks

Equality is determined by:

GetHashCode()

Serves as the default hash function.

public override int GetHashCode()

Returns

int

A hash code for the current object.

Remarks

Calculates the hash value using the integer value of Suit raised to one plus the Rank. Rank plus one is used to ensure unique hashes.

IsValidTile(Suit, int)

Returns if a given suit and rank combination corresponds to a valid tile.

public static bool IsValidTile(Suit suit, int rank)

Parameters

suit Suit

The suit to check.

rank int

The rank to check.

Returns

bool

If suit is Zi and rank is 1-7, returns true. If suit is any other suit, and rank is 0-9, returns true. Otherwise, returns false.
